entry.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html b:version='2' class='v2' expr:dir='data:blog.languageDirection' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml' xmlns:b='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/b' xmlns:data='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/data' xmlns:expr='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/expr'>
  <head>
    <b:if cond='data:blog.isMobile'>
      <meta content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,minimum-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1.0' name='viewport'/>
    <b:else/>
      <meta content='width=1100' name='viewport'/>
    </b:if>
    <b:include data='blog' name='all-head-content'/>
    <title><data:blog.pageTitle/></title>

    <b:skin><![CDATA[/*
-----------------------------------------------
Blogger Template Style
Name:     Awesome Inc.
Designer: Tina Chen
URL:      tinachen.org
----------------------------------------------- */

/* Variable definitions
   ====================
   <Variable name="keycolor" description="Main Color" type="color" default="#ffffff" value="#ffffff"/>

   <Group description="Page" selector="body">
     <Variable name="body.font" description="Font" type="font"
         default="normal normal 13px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal normal 13px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="body.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="#000000" value="#000000"/>
     <Variable name="body.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="#ffffff" value="#ffffff"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Links" selector=".main-inner">
     <Variable name="link.color" description="Link Color" type="color" default="#888888" value="#888888"/>
     <Variable name="link.visited.color" description="Visited Color" type="color" default="#444444" value="#444444"/>
     <Variable name="link.hover.color" description="Hover Color" type="color" default="#cccccc" value="#cccccc"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Blog Title" selector=".header h1">
     <Variable name="header.font" description="Title Font" type="font"
         default="normal bold 40px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal bold 40px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="header.text.color" description="Title Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)"  value="$(body.text.color)"/>
     <Variable name="header.background.color" description="Header Background" type="color" default="transparent"  value="transparent"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Blog Description" selector=".header .description">
     <Variable name="description.font" description="Font" type="font"
         default="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="description.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color"
         default="$(body.text.color)"  value="$(body.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Tabs Text" selector=".tabs-inner .widget li a">
     <Variable name="tabs.font" description="Font" type="font"
         default="normal bold 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal bold 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="tabs.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)" value="$(body.text.color)"/>
     <Variable name="tabs.selected.text.color" description="Selected Color" type="color" default="$(tabs.text.color)" value="$(tabs.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Tabs Background" selector=".tabs-outer .PageList">
     <Variable name="tabs.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="#141414" value="#141414"/>
     <Variable name="tabs.selected.background.color" description="Selected Color" type="color" default="#444444" value="#444444"/>
     <Variable name="tabs.border.color" description="Border Color" type="color" default="$(widget.border.color)" value="$(widget.border.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Date Header" selector=".main-inner .widget h2.date-header, .main-inner .widget h2.date-header span">
     <Variable name="date.font" description="Font" type="font"
         default="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="date.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="#666666" value="#666666"/>
     <Variable name="date.border.color" description="Border Color" type="color" default="$(widget.border.color)" value="$(widget.border.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Post Title" selector="h3.post-title, h4, h3.post-title a">
     <Variable name="post.title.font" description="Font" type="font"
         default="normal bold 22px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal bold 22px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="post.title.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)" value="$(body.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Post Background" selector=".post">
     <Variable name="post.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="$(widget.background.color)"  value="$(widget.background.color)"/>
     <Variable name="post.border.color" description="Border Color" type="color" default="$(widget.border.color)"  value="$(widget.border.color)"/>
     <Variable name="post.border.bevel.color" description="Bevel Color" type="color" default="$(widget.border.color)" value="$(widget.border.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Gadget Title" selector="h2">
     <Variable name="widget.title.font" description="Font" type="font"
        default="normal bold 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal bold 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="widget.title.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)" value="$(body.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Gadget Text" selector=".sidebar .widget">
     <Variable name="widget.font" description="Font" type="font"
        default="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif" value="normal normal 14px Arial, Tahoma, Helvetica, FreeSans, sans-serif"/>
     <Variable name="widget.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)" value="$(body.text.color)"/>
     <Variable name="widget.alternate.text.color" description="Alternate Color" type="color" default="#666666" value="#666666"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Gadget Links" selector=".sidebar .widget">
     <Variable name="widget.link.color" description="Link Color" type="color" default="$(link.color)" value="$(link.color)"/>
     <Variable name="widget.link.visited.color" description="Visited Color" type="color" default="$(link.visited.color)" value="$(link.visited.color)"/>
     <Variable name="widget.link.hover.color" description="Hover Color" type="color" default="$(link.hover.color)" value="$(link.hover.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Gadget Background" selector=".sidebar .widget">
     <Variable name="widget.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="#141414" value="#141414"/>
     <Variable name="widget.border.color" description="Border Color" type="color" default="#222222" value="#222222"/>
     <Variable name="widget.border.bevel.color" description="Bevel Color" type="color" default="#000000" value="#000000"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Sidebar Background" selector=".column-left-inner .column-right-inner">
     <Variable name="widget.outer.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="transparent"  value="transparent"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Images" selector=".main-inner">
     <Variable name="image.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="transparent" value="#222222"/>
     <Variable name="image.border.color" description="Border Color" type="color" default="transparent" value="transparent"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Feed" selector=".blog-feeds">
      <Variable name="feed.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)" value="$(body.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Feed Links" selector=".blog-feeds">
     <Variable name="feed.link.color" description="Link Color" type="color" default="$(link.color)" value="$(link.color)"/>
     <Variable name="feed.link.visited.color" description="Visited Color" type="color" default="$(link.visited.color)" value="$(link.visited.color)"/>
     <Variable name="feed.link.hover.color" description="Hover Color" type="color" default="$(link.hover.color)" value="$(link.hover.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Pager" selector=".blog-pager">
     <Variable name="pager.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="$(post.background.color)"  value="$(post.background.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Group description="Footer" selector=".footer-outer">
     <Variable name="footer.background.color" description="Background Color" type="color" default="$(widget.background.color)"  value="$(widget.background.color)"/>
     <Variable name="footer.text.color" description="Text Color" type="color" default="$(body.text.color)"  value="$(body.text.color)"/>
   </Group>

   <Variable name="title.shadow.spread" description="Title Shadow" type="length" default="-1px" value="-1px"/>

   <Variable name="body.background" description="Body Background" type="background"
       color="$(body.background.color)"
       default="$(color) none repeat scroll top left" value="$(color) url(http://www.blogblog.com/1kt/awesomeinc/body_background_dark.png) repeat scroll top left"/>
   <Variable name="body.background.gradient.cap" description="Body Gradient Cap" type="url"
       default="none" value="url(http://www.blogblog.com/1kt/awesomeinc/body_gradient_dark.png)"/>
   <Variable name="body.background.size" description="Body Background Size" type="string" default="auto" value="auto"/>

   <Variable name="tabs.background.gradient" description="Tabs Background Gradient" type="url"
       default="none" value="none"/>

   <Variable name="header.background.gradient" description="Header Background Gradient" type="url" default="none"  value="none"/>
   <Variable name="header.padding.top" description="Header Top Padding" type="length" default="22px"  value="22px"/>
   <Variable name="header.margin.top" description="Header Top Margin" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="header.margin.bottom" description="Header Bottom Margin" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>

   <Variable name="widget.padding.top" description="Widget Padding Top" type="length" default="8px"  value="8px"/>
   <Variable name="widget.padding.side" description="Widget Padding Side" type="length" default="15px"  value="15px"/>
   <Variable name="widget.outer.margin.top" description="Widget Top Margin" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="widget.outer.background.gradient" description="Gradient" type="url" default="none"  value="none"/>
   <Variable name="widget.border.radius" description="Gadget Border Radius" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="outer.shadow.spread" description="Outer Shadow Size" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>

   <Variable name="date.header.border.radius.top" description="Date Header Border Radius Top" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="date.header.position" description="Date Header Position" type="length" default="15px"  value="15px"/>

   <Variable name="date.space" description="Date Space" type="length" default="30px"  value="30px"/>
   <Variable name="date.position" description="Date Float" type="string" default="static"  value="static"/>
   <Variable name="date.padding.bottom" description="Date Padding Bottom" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="date.border.size" description="Date Border Size" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>
   <Variable name="date.background" description="Date Background" type="background" color="transparent"
       default="$(color) none no-repeat scroll top left"  value="$(color) none no-repeat scroll top left"/>
   <Variable name="date.first.border.radius.top" description="Date First top radius" type="length" default="$(widget.border.radius)"  value="$(widget.border.radius)"/>
   <Variable name="date.last.space.bottom" description="Date Last Space Bottom" type="length"
       default="20px"  value="20px"/>
   <Variable name="date.last.border.radius.bottom" description="Date Last bottom radius" type="length" default="$(widget.border.radius)"  value="$(widget.border.radius)"/>

   <Variable name="post.first.padding.top" description="First Post Padding Top" type="length" default="0"  value="0"/>

   <Variable name="image.shadow.spread" description="Image Shadow Size" type="length" default="0" value="0"/>
   <Variable name="image.border.radius" description="Image Border Radius" type="length" default="0" value="0"/>

   <Variable name="separator.outdent" description="Separator Outdent" type="length" default="15px"  value="15px"/>
   <Variable name="title.separator.border.size" description="Widget Title Border Size" type="length" default="1px"  value="1px"/>
   <Variable name="list.separator.border.size" description="List Separator Border Size" type="length" default="1px"  value="1px"/>
   <Variable name="shadow.spread" description="Shadow Size" type="length" default="0" value="0"/>

   <Variable name="startSide" description="Side where text starts in blog language" type="automatic" default="left" value="left"/>
   <Variable name="endSide" description="Side where text ends in blog language" type="automatic" default="right" value="right"/>

   <Variable name="date.side" description="Side where date header is placed" type="string" default="$(endSide)" value="$(endSide)"/>

   <Variable name="pager.border.radius.top" description="Pager Border Top Radius" type="length" default="$(widget.border.radius)"  value="$(widget.border.radius)"/>
   <Variable name="pager.space.top" description="Pager Top Space" type="length" default="1em"  value="1em"/>

   <Variable name="footer.background.gradient" description="Background Gradient" type="url" default="none"  value="none"/>

   <Variable name="mobile.background.size" description="Mobile Background Size" type="string"
       default="$(body.background.size)" value="$(body.background.size)"/>
   <Variable name="mobile.background.overlay" description="Mobile Background Overlay" type="string"
       default="transparent none repeat scroll top left" value="transparent none repeat scroll top left"/>
   <Variable name="mobile.button.color" description="Mobile Button Color" type="color" default="#ffffff"  value="#ffffff"/>
*/

/* Content
----------------------------------------------- */
body {
  font: $(body.font);
  color: $(body.text.color);
  background: $(body.background);
}

html body .content-outer {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  width: 100%;
}

a:link {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: $(link.color);
}

a:visited {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: $(link.visited.color);
}

a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  color: $(link.hover.color);
}

.body-fauxcolumn-outer .cap-top {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1;

  height: 276px;
  width: 100%;

  background: transparent $(body.background.gradient.cap) repeat-x scroll top left;
  _background-image: none;
}

/* Columns
----------------------------------------------- */
.content-inner {
  padding: 0;
}

.header-inner .section {
  margin: 0 16px;
}

.tabs-inner .section {
  margin: 0 16px;
}

.main-inner {
  padding-top: $(date.space);
}

.main-inner .column-center-inner,
.main-inner .column-left-inner,
.main-inner .column-right-inner {
  padding: 0 5px;
}

*+html body .main-inner .column-center-inner {
  margin-top: -$(date.space);
}

#layout .main-inner .column-center-inner {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Header
----------------------------------------------- */
.header-outer {
  margin: $(header.margin.top) 0 $(header.margin.bottom) 0;
  background: $(header.background.color) $(header.background.gradient) repeat scroll 0 0;
}

.Header h1 {
  font: $(header.font);
  color: $(header.text.color);
  text-shadow: 0 0 $(title.shadow.spread) #000000;
}

.Header h1 a {
  color: $(header.text.color);
}

.Header .description {
  font: $(description.font);
  color: $(description.text.color);
}

.header-inner .Header .titlewrapper,
.header-inner .Header .descriptionwrapper {
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.header-inner .Header .titlewrapper {
  padding-top: $(header.padding.top);
}

/* Tabs
----------------------------------------------- */
.tabs-outer {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background: $(tabs.background.color) $(tabs.background.gradient) repeat scroll 0 0;
}

#layout .tabs-outer {
  overflow: visible;
}

.tabs-cap-top, .tabs-cap-bottom {
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;

  border-top: 1px solid $(tabs.border.color);

}

.tabs-cap-bottom {
  bottom: 0;
}

.tabs-inner .widget li a {
  display: inline-block;

  margin: 0;
  padding: .6em 1.5em;

  font: $(tabs.font);
  color: $(tabs.text.color);

  border-top: 1px solid $(tabs.border.color);
  border-bottom: 1px solid $(tabs.border.color);
  border-$startSide: 1px solid $(tabs.border.color);

  height: 16px;
  line-height: 16px;
}

.tabs-inner .widget li:last-child a {
  border-$endSide: 1px solid $(tabs.border.color);
}

.tabs-inner .widget li.selected a, .tabs-inner .widget li a:hover {
  background: $(tabs.selected.background.color) $(tabs.background.gradient) repeat-x scroll 0 -100px;
  color: $(tabs.selected.text.color);
}

/* Headings
----------------------------------------------- */
h2 {
  font: $(widget.title.font);
  color: $(widget.title.text.color);
}

/* Widgets
----------------------------------------------- */
.main-inner .section {
  margin: 0 27px;
  padding: 0;
}

.main-inner .column-left-outer,
.main-inner .column-right-outer {
  margin-top: $(widget.outer.margin.top);
}

#layout .main-inner .column-left-outer,
#layout .main-inner .column-right-outer {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.main-inner .column-left-inner,
.main-inner .column-right-inner {
  background: $(widget.outer.background.color) $(widget.outer.background.gradient) repeat 0 0;

  -moz-box-shadow: 0 0 $(outer.shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 $(outer.shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -goog-ms-box-shadow: 0 0 $(outer.shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 $(outer.shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);

  -moz-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -webkit-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -goog-ms-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
}

#layout .main-inner .column-left-inner,
#layout .main-inner .column-right-inner {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.sidebar .widget {
  font: $(widget.font);
  color: $(widget.text.color);
}

.sidebar .widget a:link {
  color: $(widget.link.color);
}

.sidebar .widget a:visited {
  color: $(widget.link.visited.color);
}

.sidebar .widget a:hover {
  color: $(widget.link.hover.color);
}

.sidebar .widget h2 {
  text-shadow: 0 0 $(title.shadow.spread) #000000;
}

.main-inner .widget {
  background-color: $(widget.background.color);
  border: 1px solid $(widget.border.color);
  padding: 0 $(widget.padding.side) 15px;
  margin: 20px -16px;

  -moz-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -goog-ms-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);

  -moz-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -webkit-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -goog-ms-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
}

.main-inner .widget h2 {
  margin: 0 -$(separator.outdent);
  padding: .6em $(separator.outdent) .5em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $(widget.border.bevel.color);
}

.footer-inner .widget h2 {
  padding: 0 0 .4em;

  border-bottom: 1px solid $(widget.border.bevel.color);
}

.main-inner .widget h2 + div, .footer-inner .widget h2 + div {
  border-top: $(title.separator.border.size) solid $(widget.border.color);
  padding-top: $(widget.padding.top);
}

.main-inner .widget .widget-content {
  margin: 0 -$(separator.outdent);
  padding: 7px $(separator.outdent) 0;
}

.main-inner .widget ul, .main-inner .widget #ArchiveList ul.flat {
  margin: -$(widget.padding.top) -15px 0;
  padding: 0;

  list-style: none;
}

.main-inner .widget #ArchiveList {
  margin: -$(widget.padding.top) 0 0;
}

.main-inner .widget ul li, .main-inner .widget #ArchiveList ul.flat li {
  padding: .5em 15px;
  text-indent: 0;

  color: $(widget.alternate.text.color);

  border-top: $(list.separator.border.size) solid $(widget.border.color);
  border-bottom: 1px solid $(widget.border.bevel.color);
}

.main-inner .widget #ArchiveList ul li {
  padding-top: .25em;
  padding-bottom: .25em;
}

.main-inner .widget ul li:first-child, .main-inner .widget #ArchiveList ul.flat li:first-child {
  border-top: none;
}

.main-inner .widget ul li:last-child, .main-inner .widget #ArchiveList ul.flat li:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.post-body {
  position: relative;
}

.main-inner .widget .post-body ul {
  padding: 0 2.5em;
  margin: .5em 0;

  list-style: disc;
}

.main-inner .widget .post-body ul li {
  padding: 0.25em 0;
  margin-bottom: .25em;

  color: $(body.text.color);

  border: none;
}

.footer-inner .widget ul {
  padding: 0;

  list-style: none;
}

.widget .zippy {
  color: $(widget.alternate.text.color);
}

/* Posts
----------------------------------------------- */
body .main-inner .Blog {
  padding: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1em;

  background-color: transparent;
  border: none;

  -moz-box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  -goog-ms-box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
}

.main-inner .section:last-child .Blog:last-child {
  padding: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1em;
}

.main-inner .widget h2.date-header {
  margin: 0 -15px 1px;
  padding: 0 0 $(date.padding.bottom) 0;

  font: $(date.font);
  color: $(date.text.color);

  background: $(date.background);

  border-top: $(date.border.size) solid $(date.border.color);
  border-bottom: 1px solid $(widget.border.bevel.color);

  -moz-border-radius-topleft: $(date.header.border.radius.top);
  -moz-border-radius-topright: $(date.header.border.radius.top);
  -webkit-border-top-left-radius: $(date.header.border.radius.top);
  -webkit-border-top-right-radius: $(date.header.border.radius.top);
  border-top-left-radius: $(date.header.border.radius.top);
  border-top-right-radius: $(date.header.border.radius.top);

  position: $(date.position);
  bottom: 100%;
  $(date.side): $(date.header.position);
  text-shadow: 0 0 $(title.shadow.spread) #000000;
}

.main-inner .widget h2.date-header span {
  font: $(date.font);
  display: block;
  padding: .5em 15px;
  border-left: $(date.border.size) solid $(date.border.color);
  border-right: $(date.border.size) solid $(date.border.color);
}

.date-outer {
  position: relative;
  margin: $(date.space) 0 20px;
  padding: 0 15px;

  background-color: $(post.background.color);
  border: 1px solid $(post.border.color);

  -moz-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  -goog-ms-box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 $(shadow.spread) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2);

  -moz-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -webkit-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  -goog-ms-border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
  border-radius: $(widget.border.radius);
}

.date-outer:first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.date-outer:last-child {
  margin-bottom: $(date.last.space.bottom);

  -moz-border-radius-bottomleft: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  -moz-border-radius-bottomright: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  -webkit-border-bottom-left-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  -webkit-border-bottom-right-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  -goog-ms-border-bottom-left-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  -goog-ms-border-bottom-right-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  border-bottom-left-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
  border-bottom-right-radius: $(date.last.border.radius.bottom);
}

.date-posts {
  margin: 0 -$(separator.outdent);
  padding: 0 $(separator.outdent);

  clear: both;
}

.post-outer, .inline-ad {
  border-top: 1px solid $(post.border.bevel.color);

            if (entry.gd$extendedProperty) {
              for (var k in entry.gd$extendedProperty) {

                  comment.deleteclass += ' ' + entry.gd$extendedProperty[k].value;
                } else if (entry.gd$extendedProperty[k].name == 'blogger.displayTime') {

entry.title: Day 29, END
entry.content: Ending my log here. Flight to Portland was delayed to 8:40 or so, so we got into PDX around 9:55. Claimed our seven bags, then took the MAX to Beaverton TC. My dad's friend picked us up and took us home. Unpacked partially, but I'm going to sleep now. It's been a really, really long day.

entry.title: Day 29, part 4
entry.content:
Loooong day. Spent about 12 hours on the plane.

Most of it was listening to music, watching How I Met Your Mother, playing Tiny Wings, and sleeping. Fairly boring flight. They did offer Cup Noodles at one point, which leads me to wonder what it's like to prepare 300 Cup Noodles at the same time.

Now sitting in Canada's Vancouver International Airport (YVR).

Free wifi, and it's much faster than Hong Kong's.

Flight to Portland departs at 8:15PM and arrives at 9:31.

entry.title: Day 29, part 3
entry.content:
It's now 6:24 PM local time, about an hour away from departure.

Spent the afternoon doing some DNS stuff on the computer. Parents had lunch at Fairwood, while I watched. Notably, a hanging lamp over one of the table (not ours) broke and crashed onto the table. I don't think anyone was hurt.

Went to have a final bubble tea at Chatime, a little tea outlet in the airport.

Went to Burger King but wasn't super hungry, so just picked up a bag of onion rings.

Snacked on those, passed through security (pretty quickly), and had a M&M (here, funnily enough, called Smarties) McFlurry. The sugar levels are insane.

Rode the people mover to gates 33-80, and found our way to gate 47. Estimated flight duration is 11 hours 45 minutes, getting us back to Vancouver at 4:10 PM Wednesday local time.

From that point on, I'll be back in local Pacific time. YVR-PDX departs at 8:15, meaning a four over layover in Vancouver.

I'll probably post again then.

See you in twelve hours.

entry.title: Day 29, continued
entry.content:
Now sitting at Hong Kong airport waiting to check-in. I was wrong, the flight leaves at 7:25, so we won't able to check in for another hour or so.

Ate lunch at Mos Burger, a Japanese burger chain. Food was acceptable but not awesome.

Walked around the mall for a bit, then took the Airport Express. It was fast, but not insanely so.

Kind of bored. This wifi sucks.

entry.title: Day 29
entry.content:
Last day in Hong Kong! Plane leaves at 5PM, but we have to check out of the hotel by 12PM noon, which is in about an hour.

So I woke up at 11AM, and my uncle will take us to the airport, (my sister and I to Tsing Yi station, where we'll try out the Airport Express, averaging 130 km/h).

There, we'll have free internet and and unfree food, which is better than hanging around the hotel all day.

entry.title: Day 28
entry.content:
Woke up fairly early today (like 9:30AM) in order to go visit my grandparents. Took a bus up to Sheung Shui, which is a long way from the hotel, and the bus ride took about an hour.

Had BBQ pork and rice at Fairwood, a Chinese fast food place similar to Cafe de Coral.

Got a mango cake and some other assorted snacks to bring to the my grandparents, then walked to the home for the aged where they live.

I played some Tiny Wings and Monopoly, said farewells to the grandparents, and ate the mango cake.

Came back on the train, which also took a long time, and rode the shuttle back to the hotel.

Relaxed for a bit, then headed out to a farewell dinner with a ton of mother's side relatives. Took a lot of pictures.

Had a quick ice cream at Burger King, then bought a oreo-cream milk tea. I wasn't able to drink it until after I got back to the hotel, at which point the Oreos were already fairly soft and soaked. We're now packing our stuff for tomorrow. We came in with five suitcases and are leaving with six.

This laptop will the last thing packed, and tomorrow morning I'll just grab it and go.

entry.title: Day 27
entry.content:
Woke up really late, since the final dragged on forever, with extra time and the penalty shootout. US didn't really convert on their superior attacking, and the first half was fairly dull, but got really exciting near the end. Good job to Japan for pulling out the win.

So, slept, woke up at around 2:30. Went out to Wan Chai to have lunch and egg tarts, which were really good.

Bought a bubble tea, then walked to the Golden Bauhinia Square, featuring a statue as a gift from China. Rode a tram to the Peak Tram station, where we waited in line a loooong time to ride the tram to the Peak. Once up there, we got lost in the Peak Tower briefly, then got out and took some pictures. Nice views from up there.

Had dinner at Burger King on the Peak, then stood in line for a long time (again) to get back down. Took a bus to the Central ferry pier, where we rode the Star Ferry across the harbor to Tsim Sha Tsui.

Had a quick snack at McDonald's (11PM snack), then took the MTR back to Tsuen Wan and minibus 96M back to the hotel.

Played some solitaire and Tiny Wings, and it's nearly 4AM now. Time for bed! It's actually kind of nice that our sleep schedules are pretty messed up, because it'll be easier to readjust to US time.

entry.title: Day 26
entry.content:
Woke up around 1PM, went out to have a lunch of noodles with my dad. We dropped off some laundry at the dry cleaners', and then went to Japan Home Center to get a bamboo chair mat and a bed mat. They're really cool in the summer, when sleeping on a plain bed makes you sweaty.

Went home, then arranged a dinner with my second cousin and aunts, etc. Been to the place before, so fish and rice again.

Ate, then went on a nighttime shopping trip to the Golden Computer Arcade in Sham Shui Po. Bought a mouse, a DVI-HDMI adapter, and a HDMI cable.

Had a snack at a dessert place of fresh fruit, which was pretty cool.

Went home, and tried to get my Macbook connected to the hotel TV, but failed. I hope it's a problem wit hte TV and not with my cables.

Skyped for a while with Sovo, now going to watch the final of the Women's World Cup.

entry.title: Day 25
entry.content:
Woke up at 10:30 (really early by my standards).

Went out for a buffet lunch with my father's side relatives. This was at a hotel by Disneyland, which was kind of weird. Food kinda sucked, so I ate mostly dessert and ice cream.

Afterward, visited my cousin Kelsey's new apartment, which she's moving into as she's getting married next January. Played a bit of Kinect, which is pretty cool.

We then went to Times Square in Causeway Bay, which had a huge Harry Potter exhibit thing going on. The crowds were massive. We may also have seen Daniel Radcliffe, because there was some guy in a suit who was waving to the crowds while the aforementioned crowds went wild and snapped pictures like crazy. I'm not sure, because I was too far away to tell.

In any case. . . had dinner at Tony Roma's, which we used to go to before it went out of business in the United States. Ribs are still good.

Went to IKEA (again), this time to actually buy stuff. Got a nice side/back sleeper pillow and another one of those nice cheap plastic boxes. Also picked up two lint rollers for $10 HKD apiece. I love being organized. Didn't eat at IKEA this time.

Came back to Tsuen Wan, where we had a quick snack of froyo, and then walked over to explore another hotel in Tsuen Wan that we might choose next time. It's a little bit cheaper, but the rooms are very small. However, I don't need a lot of space, and this hotel has the advantage of being located in the Tsuen Wan city center, which means no more conforming to annoying hotel shuttles.

Came back home. Four more days in Hong Kong. The fourth day, due to time zone changes, will be a very long day.

EDIT: Turns out it was the Weasley twins from the movie.

entry.title: Day 24
entry.content:
Sorry this post is late. . . I was too lazy to post last night.

So, I woke up at 1:30 PM and went to McDonald's in Hung Hom for lunch.

We walked to the science museum and went in. It still has the usual display of cool stuff, including a mirror house that offers mirrors allowing you to view your profile and your back side. They did take out the vertical jump test, which sucked.

There was also a special exhibition on Albert Einstein, including animations of several of his theories and original documents belonging to Einstein.

Pretty cool stuff. Went to IKEA in Sha Tin, where we walked around the whole place, as opposed to last time's quick glance. Saw some more cool stuff. Ate at the IKEA restaurant, which has some nice food. Loved the tiramisu and the Swedish meatballs were pretty good too. Had some watermelon juice as well.

Finished walking and had a quick snack at the IKEA bistro, hot dog and popcorn.

It was late by then, so we went home.

entry.title: Day 23
entry.content:
I should start this from 12AM last night, since we did a lot and slept really late. . .

So, I registered for my classes. Had to switch to basketball PE, which was like my. . . sixth choice. My schedule's on my FB profile if you'd like to see it.

After that, I followed both semifinal games of the Women's World Cup, but couldn't watch the actual games, which sucked. US vs Japan for the title!

I also played some iphone games with my second cousin, which was pretty cool. We went to sleep at about. . . 5AM.

So I sleep for eight hours, and get up at 1PM. We go out to watch Transformers at the Megabox cinema. It's not that great, weak plot, just flashy explosions and crashing metal. Good if all you want to see is action, but after two hours, everything's grating.

We then walked around the IKEA a couple floors below, which was essentially the same as the last one. Bought a little plastic box for $18 HKD, which is a bit more than $2 USD. Ate a hot dog, popcorn, and ice cream for another $12 HKD, which is about $1.50 USD.

Then went down to a soccer field, where we were going to play some soccer, but the game was called off due to rain. So we went and just played some 1v1, which was fun.

Playing soccer in Hong Kong's heat and humidity really sucks. I sweated probably. . . a pint of liquid.

Showered, then ate a small dinner. I wasn't that hungry.

So here comes the not-so-fun part. The last shuttle from Tsuen Wan station to the hotel leaves at 10:40PM. I left my second cousins' house at around 9:50, but only managed to arrive at 10:49. Undaunted, I walk the 15 minutes or so to the Nina Tower bus terminus, which takes a bit longer than it should due to my getting lost and having to cross roads through skybridges and walk through a couple of malls.

I arrive at the Nina Tower bus terminus, where route 53 passes by Ting Kau, a 2 minute walk from the hotel. A bus pulls up, and the driver comes to tell me that one just left and I'll probably have to wait 35 minutes for the next one.

So I walk over to the Tsuen Wan West bus terminus, where route 234B also passes by Ting Kau. It's a long walk, because the 234B bus stop is waaaay at the end of the terminus. So I get there, see the route runs until 22:45, and think I'm fine.

The problem is that I forgot 22:45 is 10:45 and not 11:45, which is a dumb mistake. I tend to double the 11 and think 22, so it's 11PM. But it turns out there won't be any more 234A, a fact I realize after 10 minutes of pointless waiting.

The 53 bus driver told me the bus would leave at 11:40, so I glance at my iphone, and see it's 11:33. I "OMG" internally, and begin a mad dash (well, speedwalk) back to the Nina Tower, which I get to at 11:38. I get on the bus, pay $9.7 HKD (which is ridiculous, but it's because the bus runs a long way and I'm getting off at a really early stop. Bus fares in Hong Kong are based on distance from final destination, regardless of where you actually want to get off).

The bus delivers me to Ting Kau, where I walk up a long flight of stairs, get to the hotel, and blog about this.

Did I mention that 1)I'm still sore from yesterday's workout, and 2)All this took place in 85 degree Hong Kong weather with 80% humidity? It sucked.

Time for bed?

entry.title: Day 22
entry.content:
Slept in, rewatched the first half of Finding Nemo, which was awesome.

Had a bubble tea, fried fish, and rice noodles at a small restaurant for a late lunch.

Went out to 24 hour fitness, which is called California Fitness here. Worked out for an hour, then had a mango juice at a local snack place.

Went to Kowloon where the International Commerce Center is, and went up to the Sky100 observation deck. Even with the discount, the prices are kind of exorbitant. $300 HKD, and the view, while pretty nice, isn't really that engaging and there isn't a whole lot to do.

Afterward, went to my second cousins' house, where I ate a lot of dinner, took some pictures, etc.

Registration for Duke is at 12AM tonight, which is in about 15 minutes. Hopefully I get my classes.

entry.title: Day 21
entry.content:
Was going to go to Science Museum, but it was raining super hard, so decided not to.

Stayed home, jailbroke my iphone, figured out how to sync my email, todo list, and calendar apps between phone and igoogle. I feel really accomplished.

For dinner, went out with a lot of mother's side relatives, including two aunts, my grandmother, and cousin. Ate fish and rice.

Came home.

entry.title: Day 20
entry.content:
Woke up, went out to Sha Tin government offices to finally apply for my Hong Kong passport. I'll be able to get a China permit next time I come back.

Afterward, had a quick lunch of substandard fried rice.

We then walked to IKEA, which happened to be nearby. The place is absolutely massive, in Hong Kong terms. It occupies two entire floors of a mall, and is laid out in a straight line, so you have to walk from one end to the other, seeing all their stuff. They have a little cafe at the end, where you can buy pizza for $8 HKD, ice cream for $2, popcorn for $4, and hot dogs for $6. Incredibly, incredibly cheap.

After that, we went to Kowloon to the ICC and Sky100 observation deck. Turns out that there's a better deal on Wednesdays, so we'll go back on Wednesday. Instead we spent the afternoon being preached to by a property management company that wanted us to buy their exorbitantly expensive apartments. Nice places, but at up to $100 million HKD, I won't be getting one anytime soon. Experienced a high speed elevator up to the 86th floor, which was pretty awesome.

Went to dinner with two aunts and family. Ate some stuff, came back home.

Bedtime.

entry.title: Day 19
entry.content:
Woke up late again. Watched some TV and ate some Pocky.

Afterward, headed out at 3PM to Tai Wai to have a late lunch at the one place that we went to about 10 times last trip. They've changed the menu, and it's not quite as good.

Went to dinner with my aunt and my second cousins' mom, and had fish and rice. Really good.

Bedtime!

entry.title: Day 18
entry.content:
Woke up late again, 12PM or so.

Went out, had McDonald's for lunch, had some frozen yogurt, got some mango rolls from a local bakery, bought some mango-orange juice and Pocky from a grocery store.

Came home, took a nap.

For dinner, headed out to City Landmark I for Pizza Hut. They like putting a lot of cheese on their pizza. Had a bubble tea and came back home.

entry.title: Day 17
entry.content:
Boring first half and more eventful second half.

Woke up late, like 12PM, had lunch at Cafe de Coral, BBQ pork and rice.

Had ice cream from Burger King right next door and a bubble tea.

Came home, got destroyed at Monopoly, hung around at the hotel.

Went out with my sister and dad to my aunt's house for dinner. Had four bowls of rice with fish. Delicious and awesome.

Watched my sister play a lot of Wii Fit, then left.

This is where the interesting part starts:

We're walking out to the bus stop to catch a bus back to the hotel when, on the road right in front of us, a taxi tries to overtake a Coca-Cola truck, the driver of the truck doesn't like it and tries to speed up to cut off the taxi, and rear-ends the hell out of the taxi, spinning it 180 degrees around.

This causes a giant traffic jam that stretches all the way about four intersections. My aunt drops us off at a different bus stop, but the traffic jam's blocking the double-decker buses from getting through, so the line for the bus is at least a hundred strong and we're probably the only ones who know why. We jump out of line for the MTR, which, reliably, gets us back to Tsuen Wan (albeit through a long detour and two interchanges).

At this point, the hotel shuttles have stopped running, because the last one leaves at 10:45 and by now it's 12AM.

We try to get a minibus back, but it's only got one seat left and we don't want to ditch people. Worse, the driver says it's the last bus.

Our only option left is a taxi, which is significantly more expensive. The fare comes out to 43.50 HKD, but my dad pays the guy $50 for his trouble, since he had to get us all the way out into the middle of nowhere for the hotel and probably won't get any more customers until he drives all way back to the city center.

So I got home late. Played some Minecraft, bed now.

entry.title: Day 16
entry.content:
Picked up my Hong Kong ID card.

Ate lunch at Burger King.

Hung around at home. Watched Megamind, and a lot of TV.

Boring day.

entry.title: Day 15
entry.content:
Did very little. Woke up, had lunch with relatives.

Had snack with some of my dad's old friends.

Had McDonald's for dinner.

Slept.

entry.title: Day 14
entry.content:
Spent the day at Ocean Park, Hong Kong's biggest amusement park and a major tourist attraction. The place is really full, long lines for every ride. The content is pretty neat, with rides, animals, aquariums, trained dolphin shows, etc. The number of other people and the massive heat and humidity kinda ruin it though.

Ate dinner at a local place, came home. Feet sore from walking. Showered.

Slept.

entry.title: Day 13
entry.content:
Didn't do much today either.

Woke up, had some Cafe de Coral for lunch.

Bought a cake, came back.

Played some computer games and watched some TV for the afternoon, then went out for dinner.

Walked around Tsuen Wan's Citywalk and Nina Tower, and had Cafe de Coral again for dinner, although different meal.

Came home, ate a Pocky. Sleep now.

entry.title: Day 12
entry.content:
Didn't do much today. Woke up, bought a couple games for my iPhone since EA's having a big 99 cent sale.

Went out, bought some Pocky and drinks, ate Burger King for lunch.

Came back, relaxed, went to the gym.

Had Cafe de Coral for dinner, BBQ pork and rice. It was pretty good.

Finished it off with a Burger King $2 HKD cone.

Sleepytime.

entry.title: Day 11
entry.content:
Woke up, played some 2v2v2 Warlight, which this time we owned at. My mom brought me takeout McDonald's for lunch.

Hung around in the hotel room for another couple hours, then went out to have a dinner with a ton of relatives.

Played some Mahjong, which was fun.

Dinner wasn't really my thing, so we talked (mostly), and then came back really late, like 12AM. Had a ramen and went to bed.

entry.title: Day 10
entry.content:
Woke up around 11AM and played a bit of Warlight, which Isaac and I got owned at.

Went out with my second cousin, Ivan, and had some congee for lunch.

Took a bus out to Stanley, on Hong Kong Island's southern coast, and walked around for a while. Really salty air, and it was hot. And humid. I sweated a lot.

Got some pictures of the ferry pier, the harbor, and a few in Central (downtown Hong Kong).

After a long hour on a double-decker bus to get back to Tsim Sha Tsui, walked around a lot again.

It's super crowded, had fried fish and soy sauce with rice for dinner (sooo good).

Walked around more again, looked in an arcade, which is absolutely full of hardcore gamers.

Rode the MTR back to the hotel.

Long day. Sleep now.

entry.title: Day 9
entry.content:
Had ramen for breakfast.

Hung out at the hotel until around 4PM, then left to visit my second cousin, whose dad is a chef and makes really really good fried fish. He also does a great steamed fish.

I ate a lot of fish.

I then played a lot of video games, including soccer and Dragonball Z.

It's now 1AM and I should sleep soon.

entry.title: Day 8
entry.content:
Went out for breakfast with my grandmother's friend and my cousin, then had Burger King's Tendergrill chicken sandwich, which is really good. Also had two of their ice cream cones, which are an incredible deal at $2 HKD each.

Had some bubble tea, which I couldn't finish because I was completely full. It rained a lot.

Came home, then went out for dinner with another one of my dad's old co-workers, had some fish+fried rice, and a lot of mousse and tiramisu.

Lot of eating today. Sleeping now.

entry.title: Day 7
entry.content:
Had cup noodles for breakfast, then went out for ramen (real kind) for lunch. Shopped for a bamboo mat, came home.

Went out for dinner with some of my dad's old co-workers, then came home.

Will sleep now.

entry.title: Day 6
entry.content:
Went out to government offices to try to apply for a HK passport, which apparently you need now to get a visa to China. Couldn't get it, because I only have a temporary HK permanent resident card, because the real one hasn't been made yet. I hate bureaucracy.

Went up to my aunt's place, played some Mario Party, had some dim sum.

Went back home, went to the (ill-equipped) gym, showered, played some Cribbage, listened to music.

Had dinner at Burger King. It's nice, with a wide selection of food and free wi-fi.

Going to sleep now.

entry.title: Day 5, continued
entry.content:
Ended up going to KFC, which kinda sucked.

Bought a headphone splitter for my iphone, so i can share songs with people.

Came back, had the same Vietnamese noodles for dinner.

Slept.

entry.title: Day 5
entry.content:
Had some ramen and crackers/cookies/biscuits for breakfast. I want to find a KFC or Burger King for lunch.

And drink bubble tea.

entry.title: Day 4, continued
entry.content:
Had a bit of ramen for lunch (the instant noodle kind), then went to visit my grandparents. Had lunch/dinner around 3PM with a giant buffet, with plenty of ice cream, fish, and fried rice.

Now back home, may have a light dinner, then bed.

entry.title: Day 4
entry.content:
Day 3 ended with me eating McDonald's, coming home, and sleeping.

Couldn't sleep that well, so woke up at 4AM.

Watched some TV, played a lot of iPhone games.

It's now 10AM, and I don't know what I'm doing today.

entry.title: Day 3, continued
entry.content:
Headed out to government offices in Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island, ate Cafe de Coral again, then headed to Toys R Us to look for a cribbage board. Couldn't find one, so had some bubble tea, and then came back to the hotel.

Will go out for dinner later. We eat out every day here.

entry.title: Day 3
entry.content: Just woke up, and I'm not quite sure yet what we're doing today. It's 7AM, I'm still going to sleep and waking up really early.

entry.title: Day 2, end
entry.content:
Destroyed my sister at Cribbage (something like 126 to 110)

Had Vietnamese noodles for dinner. Watched some TV. Went to sleep.

Basically a lot of eating and shopping, etc. Walked around Tsuen Wan Plaza, which is a pretty nice mall and not too far away from the hotel.

Will go out for dinner later.

I realize that so far most of my highlights have been food-related.

entry.title: Day 2
entry.content:
Watched some TV, slept. Now 8AM, we'll head out soon to do more administrative stuff, like apply for a permit to visit China.

I'm going to eat some Pocky.

entry.title: Day 1, end
entry.content:

Went home, took a shower, figured out how to set up my Macbook as an access point for my mobile devices. Fairly productive evening.

Day 2's technically starting now, so I should go to sleep.

entry.title: Day 1, continued
entry.content:
Explored the hotel amenities, which sound cooler than they really are.

Went out, ate at McDonald's. Walked around a bit more, did some administrative stuff, bought a cable for my phone, came back. May go out to dinner later. Fairly boring day.

entry.title: Day 1
entry.content:
Slept fitfully through the night. It's currently 6AM, and it seems to be raining heavily outside. The government offers free wifi in about 380 locations, so I should be able to stay connected with my iphone.

Now, gotta decide what to eat for breakfast.

entry.title: End of Day 0
entry.content:
Arrived at HKG around 5:47 PM HKT after a 13.5 hour flight. Flight was relatively uneventful, my AVOD kept crashing, so I just read and listened to music and slept for the most part.

Food was actually decent, for airline food.

Now in the Royal View Hotel, which doesn't have free wifi, and instead forces guests to pay for Ethernet. Lame, but that's how it is. Last time I was lucky enough to "borrow" somebody else's signal.

entry.title: Day 0, Part 2
entry.content:
Sitting at PDX, blogging. Checked in on Facebook, am now blogging. Played some more Shower Buddy and ate some Panda Express for breakfast. Boarding time is 9:50AM, arriving in Vancouver around 11:30.

There'll be free Wi-Fi in Vancouver, too. And Canadians.

entry.title: Day 0
entry.content:
Technically Day 0 doesn't begin until 9AM PDT, but I'll post now because we just woke up and are about to head out to the airport. We'll enjoy a continental breakfast (standard fare at most motels), and take the free shuttle to PDX (Portland International Airport).

There'll be free Wi-Fi, so I'll add to this later.

entry.title: Day -1, Part 2
entry.content:
The day, continued:

We left the house around 12PM local time, had lunch at Pho Wah (excellent pho), then drove to Super 8 motel by the airport.

While here, we played some Shower Buddy, made use of the free Wi-Fi (as I'm doing now), and walked about a mile out to IKEA and YoCream, a local frozen yogurt place. Walked back, suffered some allergy pain, and am currently sitting bored in the room.

Why? My dad left his media player remote at home, which means they have to ride the hotel shuttle out to Cascades MAX station, MAX back to Beaverton, get a ride back home, pick up the remote, get a ride back to the MAX station, ride the MAX back to Cascades, and get the shuttle to drop them off back at the hotel.

They should be back around 10:30, after which we'll have dinner at Shari's. Eventful trip so far.

entry.title: Day -1
entry.content:
I'll open my log here at Day -1 of my trip.

Inter-timezone travel creates all sorts of chronological oddities, so I'll try to explain this.

I'll consider my first day in Hong Kong (local time, UTC+8), starting at 12:00AM the night after I get there.

Beaverton is at UTC-7 (PDT), for a 15-hour time difference.

Thus:
My plane leaves at 1PM June 20 in Vancouver, BC (UTC-7), in Hong Kong 4AM, June 21.
Flight lasts 13 hours, so I arrive at HKG at 2AM PDT, June 21 and 5PM Hong Kong time, June 21.
Day 1 begins seven hours later, at 12AM June 22 Hong Kong time.

It is currently 9AM June 19, (12AM June 20 Hong Kong time), and so this is the beginning of Day -1.

Day 0 begins tomorrow morning at 9AM (I'll be at PDX waiting for PDX-YVR departure)

As for what I'm doing, I'm currently sitting at my computer, blogging. We'll leave the house at 12PM local time (PDT) today, stay at a hotel by the airport tonight, and arrive at the airport tomorrow morning.
